## Figure legend — Supplementary Figure 9

> **Supplementary Figure 9.** Each surface source is enriched for a distinct set of membrane-topology architectures, but that enrichment and its genome-wide coverage are separate quantities. Bubble matrix of inclusion sources (rows) × topology features (columns) over the candidate-surfaceome universe: dot area is within-source enrichment (fraction of that source’s own calls carrying the feature) and dot color is coverage (fraction of the whole surface universe those proteins represent). CSPA is strongly glycosylation-enriched (~96% of its own calls) yet covers only ~14% of the universe, reflecting its N-glycocapture chemistry and cell-line detection limits. SURFY and UniProt show the same glycosylation enrichment at larger scale. Zero-database Sonnet rescues differ by how they were called: those called from the gene summary alone (no literature; 794) are mostly predicted secreted (55%) and glycosylated (41%), whereas those rescued only once PubMed literature was added (314) mostly lack both a transmembrane segment and a signal peptide (49%), so their surface localization is evident only from the literature.
<!-- END manuscript-legend -->

A single **bubble matrix** of 8 surface-call rows (Sonnet, the zero-DB Sonnet
rescues split into two rows, and the five databases) × 9 topology features
(columns), across the FULL any-yes-vote candidate-surfaceome universe
(6,734 genes — Sonnet yes/contextual incl. the PubMed rescue, OR any
optimized-DB vote). Each cell's dot encodes both metrics that differ only by
denominator:

- **dot area ∝ within-source enrichment** — % of that source's OWN calls carrying the feature (`|source ∩ feature| / |source|`)
- **dot color = coverage** — % of the whole surface universe those proteins represent (`|source ∩ feature| / |universe|`)

CSPA × glycosylation is a large, mid-tone dot (~96% of its own calls but ~14% of the
universe — its N-glycocapture chemistry); SURFY/UniProt show the same glyco
enrichment at larger scale (dark, high-coverage). The **1,108 zero-DB Sonnet
rescues** split by how triage called them: the 794 called from the gene summary
alone (no literature) are mostly likely-secreted (55%) and glycosylated (41%);
the 314 rescued only once PubMed literature was added most often have no TM and
no signal peptide (49%). Neither row has GPCR or GPI proteins.

## Run

Clone the gist (the script reads the bundled TSV next to it; it does not
download anything), then run it inside the clone:

```sh
git clone https://gist.github.com/95b0f4cdcaf6a6b91f57539cd1515a25.git
cd 95b0f4cdcaf6a6b91f57539cd1515a25
uv run make_topology_coverage_by_source.py
```

`uv` reads the [PyPA inline script metadata](https://packaging.python.org/en/latest/specifications/inline-script-metadata/)
header, installs matplotlib / pandas / seaborn in a one-shot env, and emits
`topology_coverage_by_source.{pdf,png}` in the current directory.

## Data + canonical generator

- **Bundled figure TSV** (`topology_coverage_by_source.tsv`): one row per
  universe GENE with the `src_*` source-inclusion flags, the optimized cutoff
  columns (`uniprot_optimized` / `cspa_optimized` / `n_sources_optimized`), and
  the 9 topology binary features on FULL genome-wide coverage, plus
  `verdict_source` (`ncbi` = first-pass triage on the gene summary;
  `pubmed_rescue` = called only by a PubMed rescue lane) and `rescue_run`
  (which rescue lane; empty for `ncbi`). Built offline by
  [`scripts/build_figure_tsvs.py`](https://github.com/Deliverome-Project/accessible-surfaceome/blob/main/scripts/build_figure_tsvs.py)
  from the full-universe source `per_protein_features_topology_full.tsv`, which
  is produced by
  [`scripts/tsv-export/export_s9_full_universe_features.py`](https://github.com/Deliverome-Project/accessible-surfaceome/blob/main/scripts/tsv-export/export_s9_full_universe_features.py)
  — that export carries the UniProt REST + D1 (`topology_public`) pulls that give
  every gene, including the 1,108 zero-DB Sonnet rescues the M1 feature table
  never scored, its real topology. (The earlier M1-limited source missed many
  zero-DB rescues and left their topology unscored, so the Sonnet-only row read
  as misleadingly empty.)
- **Canonical generator** (uses the in-repo `_plotting_config`):
  [`scripts/figures/topology_coverage_by_source.py`](https://github.com/Deliverome-Project/accessible-surfaceome/blob/main/scripts/figures/topology_coverage_by_source.py).
  The standalone script in this gist is a brand-styled mirror that reads the
  bundled TSV and renders without the project's plotting module.

## Method (brief)

The universe is the any-yes-vote union; `sonnet_only` = Sonnet-positive AND
`n_sources_optimized == 0` (1,108 genes), drawn as two rows on
`verdict_source`: `ncbi` (794) and `pubmed_rescue` (314). For each (source, feature): enrichment =
`|source ∩ feature| / |source|` (dot area), coverage = `|source ∩ feature| /
|universe|` (dot color). Topology features are derived from UniProt keywords +
features (and DeepTMHMM for the last), following
`scripts/audit/audit_db_vs_sonnet_inclusion.py`:

- `topo_gpi_anchored`: UniProt keyword `GPI-anchor`.
- `topo_gpcr_7tm`: keyword `G-protein coupled receptor` AND `tm_count ≥ 5`.
- `topo_multi_pass_tm`: `tm_count ≥ 2` (after the GPCR bucket claims).
- `topo_single_pass_tm`: `tm_count == 1`.
- `topo_signal_only_secreted`: `signal_count ≥ 1 AND tm_count == 0 AND (Secreted keyword OR no lipidation)`.
- `topo_inner_leaflet_lipidated`: `(Prenylation OR Myristate keyword) AND tm_count == 0 AND signal_count == 0` (Ras/Src-family — cytoplasmic-facing).
- `topo_no_tm_no_signal`: keyword present, `tm_count == 0 AND signal_count == 0`.
- `up_has_glyc`: UniProt `feature_glycosylation_count ≥ 1`.
- `deeptm_TM_NO_SP`: DeepTMHMM class `TM` (TM helix, no signal peptide) — from `topology_public`, genome-wide.
